title: Online Learning
passage:
A: Hey, Dina. What are you typing?
B: It's a paper for my biology course.
A: You went back to school?
B: Actually, it's an online course.
A: Online? Don't you find it lonely not being able to meet classmates?
B: Yes, sometimes. But this school is abroad, and I'm busy with my job, so it's the best pick for me.
A: Oh, you're a foreign student. Which school are you with?
B: MIT.
A: Wow. That's one of the best colleges in America. Tell me more about online education.
B: I can watch video lessons of other MIT courses for free.
A: That's great. It sounds like you're gaining a lot from this online course.
B: Yeah, I can study whenever I want. So it doesn't matter if I'm feeling tired. I can simply take a break to do something relaxing and continue later. I've already covered a lot of ground in biology and other subjects by taking online courses.
A: I know what you mean. Often you might be feeling lazy, but you still have to make the effort to go to class. But with online learning, you can catch up anytime.
B: Exactly.
A: You've changed my mind. Online learning sounds fantastic.
